summary.text: Adam Childress is the Libertarian candidate for Michigan House of Representatives District 69 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Libertarian Party convention on June 28, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as engineering manager.

paragraphs.text: Adam Childress was born in Warren, Michigan, according to Ballotpedia.
He was also the Libertarian candidate for District 69 in 2022, finishing third in the general election with 2.7% of the vote behind Democrat Jasper Martus and Republican Jesse Couch.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he lives in Flushing Township, works in engineering and design, and that his primary policy focus is individual rights.
